trainer_scp.name: Giovanni
abilities: extreme resistance to fear-based psychic attacks
strategic coordination of hostile parahuman groups
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T011 must not be engaged directly. All interactions require Level-4 clearance and remote communication protocols. SCP-T011’s access to SCP-0034 (Nidoking) and SCP-0038 (Ninetales) presents catastrophic risk.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T011 is the leader of a hostile parahuman organization responsible for multiple SCP containment breaches. Displays exceptional strategic intelligence and anomalous resistance to psychic interrogation.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Cold, calculating, and highly disciplined. Shows no emotional vulnerability.
addendum_logs: Addendum T011-A: SCP-T011 orchestrated a coordinated breach involving three Keter-class anomalies.
Addendum T011-B: SCP-T011 resisted SCP-0097 (Hypno)’s hypnosis with no measurable effect.

trainer_scp.name: Lorelei
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid prolonged exposure to SCP-T012’s cryogenic field. SCP-T012 may assist in containment of SCP-0144 (Articuno) under supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T012 displays anomalous affinity for cryogenic environments and can manipulate ice formation within a limited radius. Frequently collaborates with SCP-0087 (Dewgong) and SCP-0091 (Cloyster).
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Calm, focused, and emotionally reserved. Shows preference for cold environments.
addendum_logs: Addendum T012-A: SCP-T012 lowered ambient temperature by 18°C during stress.
Addendum T012-B: SCP-0144’s behavior stabilized in SCP-T012’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Bruno
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T013 must not be engaged physically. Personnel must maintain a minimum distance of 15 meters during training sessions.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T013 exhibits physical strength exceeding human limits and can withstand impacts from SCP-0068 (Machamp). Displays combat instincts comparable to high-threat anomalies.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Disciplined, stoic, and intensely focused. Shows unwavering loyalty to allied personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum T013-A: SCP-T013 endured a direct four-arm strike from SCP-0068.
Addendum T013-B: SCP-T013 shattered reinforced training equipment during routine exercise.

trainer_scp.name: Agatha
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must maintain spectral shielding during interaction. SCP-T014 must not be allowed near SCP-0094 (Gengar) without supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T014 displays anomalous affinity for ghost-type SCP entities, capable of communicating with and influencing spectral anomalies. Shows partial ectoplasmic signatures during stress.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Cryptic, sharp-witted, and unpredictable. Displays fascination with death-related anomalies.
addendum_logs: Addendum T014-A: SCP-T014 suppressed SCP-0093 (Haunter)’s paralysis effect.
Addendum T014-B: Ectoplasmic residue detected on SCP-T014’s clothing after containment breach.

trainer_scp.name: Lance
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T015 must not be allowed near SCP-0149 (Dragonite) during agitation cycles. Personnel must avoid aerial zones during SCP-T015’s training.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T015 displays anomalous resilience and limited atmospheric manipulation, likely influenced by prolonged exposure to draconic SCP entities. Shows exceptional combat coordination with SCP-0148 (Dragonair).
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Charismatic, intense, and highly disciplined. Displays strong protective instincts.
addendum_logs: Addendum T015-A: SCP-T015 redirected a high-speed dive attack from SCP-0149.
Addendum T015-B: Atmospheric pressure dropped by 6% during SCP-T015’s combat demonstration.

trainer_scp.name: Jessie
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T016 must be monitored during interactions with SCP-T017. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-T016’s emotional instability.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T016 is a rogue parahuman affiliated with SCP-T011’s organization. Displays anomalous survivability and unpredictable behavior patterns.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Dramatic, impulsive, and emotionally reactive. Displays strong attachment to SCP-T017.
addendum_logs: Addendum T016-A: SCP-T016 survived a fall from a 40-meter height with minor injuries.
Addendum T016-B: SCP-T016 attempted unauthorized access to SCP-0098 (Krabby).

trainer_scp.name: James
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T017 must be monitored during joint operations with SCP-T016. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T017 to high-threat anomalies.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T017 is a rogue parahuman with anomalous luck and resilience. Frequently participates in failed operations with SCP-T016, yet consistently survives.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Polite, anxious, and easily influenced. Displays strong loyalty to SCP-T016.
addendum_logs: Addendum T017-A: SCP-T017 survived SCP-0100 (Voltorb) detonation at close range.
Addendum T017-B: SCP-T017 escaped containment using improvised tools.

trainer_scp.name: Meowth
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T018 must be monitored for escape attempts. Personnel must secure all valuables.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T018 is a feline anomaly possessing human-level intelligence and speech capability. Displays advanced infiltration skills and manipulative behavior.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Clever, opportunistic, and highly social. Displays strong attachment to SCP-T016 and SCP-T017.
addendum_logs: Addendum T018-A: SCP-T018 bypassed biometric locks using improvised tools.
Addendum T018-B: SCP-T018 convinced a guard to open a containment door.

trainer_scp.name: Bill
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid allowing SCP-T019 direct access to SCP-0137 (Porygon) without supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T019 is a technological parahuman capable of interfacing with digital anomalies. Displays partial data-phase shifting during stress events.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Friendly, eccentric, and highly curious. Displays obsessive interest in anomalous data structures.
addendum_logs: Addendum T019-A: SCP-T019 partially phased into a digital containment console.
Addendum T019-B: SCP-0137 (Porygon) displayed unusual obedience toward SCP-T019.

trainer_scp.name: Nurse Joy
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T020 is not to be contained. SCP-T020 may assist in emergency medical response for SCP-related injuries.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T020 displays anomalous healing capabilities, able to stabilize injured personnel and anomalies far beyond normal medical limits. Multiple identical instances of SCP-T020 exist, origin unknown.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Calm, nurturing, and highly professional. Displays no memory of other SCP-T020 instances.
addendum_logs: Addendum T020-A: SCP-T020 stabilized a researcher injured by SCP-0038 (Ninetales) in under 30 seconds.
Addendum T020-B: Genetic scans show identical structure across all SCP-T020 instances.
